improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
improve.coach: 44% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

improve.title: Shot selection
tips: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
improve.coach: It's come up in 31% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: That's what I call neighborly football. 62% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one. There in 62% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota. Shows up in 56% of your matches. That's a calling card.
